name: humpyard
description: Routing and policy gateway for LLM agent traffic: one Rust binary that speaks OpenAI Chat, Responses and Anthropic Messages, routes by request content, fails over, and records why.

paragraphs: A gateway that sorts each LLM request onto the right model.

One small Rust binary in front of your providers: it speaks OpenAI Chat, OpenAI Responses and Anthropic Messages, routes by what each request is, fails over between providers, and tells you what it decided and why.

Agent tools such as Claude Code and Codex send a stream of very different requests: a one-line question, a 60,000-token tool loop, a sub-agent doing narrow work. Sending all of it to one model is slow or expensive. humpyard is the routing and policy layer in front of your providers.
